message:
Running command: cd /workspace && bash build.sh 'cd /gt/_work/src && rm -rf /tmp/libxml-build && cmake -S . -B /tmp/libxml-build -GNinja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=clang -DCMAKE_C_FLAGS="-fsanitize=address -fno-omit-frame-pointer -g" -DCMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS="-fsanitize=address" -DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS=OFF -DLIBXML2_WITH_PYTHON=OFF >/dev/null && ninja -C /tmp/libxml-build xmllint >/dev/null && cat > /tmp/test.html <<"EOF"
<html><head><title>x</title></head><body>hello</body></html>
EOF
for enc in ISO-2022-JP SHIFT-JIS EUC-JP UTF-16 ISO-8859-2 WINDOWS-1251 HTML ASCII; do echo ENC=$enc; ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=0 /tmp/libxml-build/xmllint --html --encode "$enc" --output /no/such/dir/out /tmp/test.html >/tmp/out 2>/tmp/err; rc=$?; echo rc=$rc; grep -E "ERROR: AddressSanitizer|heap-use|unknown encoding|failed" -m4 /tmp/err || cat /tmp/err | head -4; done'
